purpose: Public-data stress test of residual household income after SIFO reference consumption and housing costs. This is not a microdata prevalence estimate.
period_note: Housing observations are 2025 SSB data; SIFO reference budget is 2026. Values are deliberately not inflation-spliced without an explicit method.

example_family.composition: two adults, children aged 5 and 11, petrol car

interpretation: Each worked threshold is the minimum monthly disposable household income required for HR >= 0 under the selected observed housing-cost profile and the published SIFO 2026 example-family budget.
limitations: Observed housing averages are not matched to the SIFO example family at household level.
The model cannot estimate how many employed households have HR below zero without linked microdata or a defensible synthetic population.
Owner cash-flow and owner resource-cost views differ because principal repayment is saving as well as a liquidity outflow.
Geographic and household-composition variation can be large; national means are stress-test inputs, not individual budgets.
